title_sq: Shesim apartament 2+1+2 tek White Tower, Komuna e Parisit!!
description_sq:
Ofrohet për shitje apartament 2+1 i organizuar në mënyrë funksionale, me sipërfaqe totale 129.8 m² (108.2 m² sipërfaqe neto + 21.6 m² sipërfaqe e përbashkët), i pozicionuar në një godinë të re, me standarde bashkëkohore ndërtimi.

Ambient ndenjeje dhe kuzhinë
2 dhoma gjumi
2 tualete
Ballkon funksional
Korridor shpërndarës që garanton privatësi dhe organizim optimal të hapësirave

title_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale in White Tower, Paris Municipality!!
description_en: A functionally organized 2+1 apartment is offered for sale, with a total area of ​​129.8 m² (108.2 m² net area + 21.6 m² common area), located in a new building, with contemporary construction standards. The apartment is organized by: Living room and kitchen 2 bedrooms 2 bathrooms Functional balcony Distribution corridor that guarantees privacy and optimal organization of spaces The facility was built by a reputable construction company, with high quality construction, thermal and acoustic insulation, as well as a modern elevator. The area offers quick access to main services, institutions, shops and public transport.
